method: Written by hand from one frame per second (frame round(s * fps) of clip.mp4), viewed with a pixel grid. Not from YOLO or any other detector.
notes: Empty ground for 3 s, then two sparrows arrive 3 s apart and feed until the end.

birds.notes: male (orange breast) enters at the right edge at 3 s, lands by 4 s, stays
female (brown) first seen at 6 s on the upper ground, stays; near the left edge at 36-38 s
